source: Can you make a pet game where you open eggs and you break lucky blocks that give you money that make it so you can buy more pits and can you make it so these 12 areas and can you make it so to get to the areas you have to have unlocked a certain amount of pet

image_prompt.text: A central storefront zone holding the egg-opening station and the pet shop, which every player keeps returning to
Physical walls sealing each of the later areas, animating away once the player owns enough pets
Walkable circulation chaining the hub out to each of the areas
Twelve distinct areas laid out around the hub, each gated behind the one before it

layout_placement.text: Lucky blocks scattered through every area that break open and drop money

notes: The breaking of the lucky blocks is physics behaviour; the layout only places them and their respawn points.
Twelve gated areas on one shared surface, not twelve separate maps - no P4 unless the areas are meant to be separate places.
The pet count required per gate was never given.

open_questions.ask: Should the areas be bright and cartoony, or does each of the twelve have its own look?
How big is each area - a small yard, or somewhere you spend minutes walking?
How many pets does each of the twelve areas need before it opens?

coverage_missing.ask: Should the areas be bright and cartoony, or does each of the twelve have its own look?
How big is each area - a small yard, or somewhere you spend minutes walking?
How many pets does each of the twelve areas need before it opens?

answers.ask: Should the areas be bright and cartoony, or does each of the twelve have its own look?
answers.answer: Make the game bright and cartoony, with each of the 12 areas having its own simple look.

answers.ask: How big is each area - a small yard, or somewhere you spend minutes walking?
answers.answer: Make each area a small yard-sized zone so players can quickly find lucky blocks, eggs, and the next area.

answers.ask: How many pets does each of the twelve areas need before it opens?
answers.answer: Each new area should require more pets than the last, starting at 1 pet for area 2 and increasing by 1 pet per area up to 11 pets for area 12.
